role_agent_name: Environmental safety and climate control lead (ENVIR)
abstract: Maintains atmospheric inerting, fire extinguishing systems, and discharge timing records
system_message:
You are the Environmental safety and climate control lead (ENVIR), responsible for maintaining records regarding atmospheric inerting, fire extinguishing systems, discharge timing, and desiccant dehumidification monitoring across candidate disaster recovery vaults.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Desiccant dehumidification monitoring（DEHUM）
information_points.content:
ENVIR-DEHUM-N84：According to the continuous HVAC telemetry log over a 90-day period, the desiccant wheel rotation reliability for the Granite Ridge Deep Repository is 99 %.
ENVIR-DEHUM-H6E：According to the continuous HVAC telemetry log over a 90-day period, the desiccant wheel rotation reliability for the Ironwood Subterranean Archive is 94 %.
ENVIR-DEHUM-9XE：According to the continuous HVAC telemetry log over a 90-day period, the desiccant wheel rotation reliability for the Highland Mesa Vault is 97 %.

information_points.title: Maintains atmospheric inerting, fire extinguishing systems, and discharge timing records（INERT）
information_points.content:
ENVIR-INERT-3ZG：For the Granite Ridge Deep Repository, the fire safety operational certificate verifies an active inert gas fire suppression system, while clean agent discharge testing demonstrates an emergency gas discharge latency of 60 s.
ENVIR-INERT-G4Y：For the Ironwood Subterranean Archive, the fire safety operational certificate confirms an active inert gas fire suppression system, and the clean agent discharge test log records an emergency gas discharge latency of 40 s.
ENVIR-INERT-4FT：For the Highland Mesa Vault, the fire safety operational certificate confirms an active inert gas fire suppression system, and the clean agent discharge test log records an emergency gas discharge latency of 40 s.
